rationale: The plan identifies the question as a condition-by-time interaction and tests it with a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, explicitly rejecting a single-coefficient Wald test because time has four levels, and decomposes the result into per-time-point interaction coefficients and within-condition simple effects — exactly the reference approach, with the low power of a difference-of-differences at n=3 per cell stated repeatedly rather than papered over. QC (blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes coloured by condition and time, sample distances, library sizes) precedes modelling with an explicit no-drop-by-default policy; the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) is minimal and tied to the smallest cell; normalization is left inside the model with pre-scaling forbidden; reference levels are set with relevel() and both formulas appear verbatim; BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage for ranking, with ashr named for contrasts. Enrichment is preranked fgsea on the full tested list with a named collection and version, a 15-500 window applied after intersection with tested genes, a recorded seed and collapsing of redundant sets; the only soft spot is the somewhat ad hoc signed -log10(p) ranking metric, though it is stated with rationale and backed by a sensitivity ranking. The report step names methods, versions, formulas, reference levels, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, diagnostics, power caveats and a reproducibility record.
